name: aws-stepfunctions-workflow-builder
description: AWS Step Functions Visual Workflow Builder - Full Stack Application

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:lambda
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:lambda
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:lambda
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:frontend && npm run lint:fix:lambda
scripts.format: npm run format:frontend && npm run format:lambda
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:lambda
scripts.clean: npm run clean:frontend && npm run clean:lambda
scripts.clean:lambda: cd lambda-functions/deployment-lambda && npm run clean && rm -rf node_modules
scripts.deploy:prepare: npm run build && npm run package:lambda
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:prepare && npm run deploy:infrastructure
